title: docs: clarify routine secret re-uploads
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Treats unchanged secret re-uploads in existing deployment workflows as routine deployment
- Keeps explicit approval for actual credential lifecycle changes
- Prevents diagnostic searches from scanning credential stores or agent/session archives

gist.headline: Secrets, watered carefully
gist.blurb: The deployment garden now distinguishes routine secret re-uploads from actual credential changes. Diagnostic tools also know which cupboards to leave closed.
gist.summary: Updated AGENTS.md so unchanged secret re-uploads in existing deployment workflows are treated as routine, while credential lifecycle changes still require explicit approval and diagnostic searches skip credential stores and agent/session archives.
gist.impact: Contributors get clearer deployment guidance, with routine secret handling unblocked and sensitive credential or session stores kept out of diagnostic scans.
gist.visual_concept: Polli wears a tiny gardener hat and carefully waters labeled secret-seed packets already planted in a cozy deployment garden, while a locked credential cabinet and archive boxes sit safely behind a small 'DO NOT SCAN' sign. The scene represents routine handling of unchanged deployment secrets alongside deliberate protection for real credential changes and private archives.
